newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Group forms for Metrobank $140 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Metrobank $140 mln FRCD.

text.p: A group has formed for Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co's US$140 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due June 2002, the lead managers said on Tuesday.
The five-year certificates were priced at par to float at 65 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 74 basis points.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Development Bank of Singapore and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK) are lead managers.
Bank Austria's Singapore branch is co-lead manager.

Bank of Taiwan's Singapore branch, Tokai Asia, Berliner Bank, Taiwan's Asia Pacific Bank, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz, Tat Lee bank, Sumitomo Trust Finance (HK) and Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank are managers.
Signing is set for June 6 in Hong Kong. The payment date is June 12.
